name: Ndzerem
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Glottolog's sole reference is Blench & Hamm (n.d.) Nun-group survey note; no grammar/phonology of Ndzerem located

sources.citation: Roger Blench website index pages: Grassfields (GFOP.htm, the Internet Archive 2015-04-20) and Nun group (NunOP.htm, the Internet Archive 2024-05-23)
sources.note: Index pages only; the Nun page links the overview PDF and a Chufie' page; no Ndzerem wordlist or phonology is posted (the Internet Archive's index listing of the Nun folder confirms).

sources.citation: Blench, Roger & Cameron Hamm. n.d. [PDF dated 25 Jul 2010]. The Nun languages of the Grassfields of Cameroun. Circulation draft, 'various sections not written', 12 pp. Cambridge: Kay Williamson Educational Foundation / SIL. (Glottolog ref 586179)
sources.note: Nothing. Ndzerem is reported here for the first time (Table 1 p. 2; section 3.2 p. 4; section 4.11 p. 7) from 'a short wordlist taken by Cameron Hamm' (Hamm ined., 'recorded under less than ideal conditions'); about 25 Ndzerem lexical items appear in comparative Tables 5-8 (pp. 4-5) without tone marks; section 5 'Phonology' (p. 7) is an empty heading; no mention of stress, accent or tone for Ndzerem anywhere in the draft.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page ndze1235 'Ndzerem' and reference record 586179; family nodes nunm1234 (Nun MCNB) and mbam1253 (Mbam-Nkam Nun)
sources.note: No stress statement; the only reference for the language and for both family nodes is Blench & Hamm n.d. Ethnologue comment: Ndzerem 'is reported in hh:hv:BlenchHamm:Nun.. a full treatment with cognate counts and intelligibility tests is lacking'; missing from Ethnologue E16-E28.
Nothing; one-sentence stub citing only Blench & Hamm n.d.

sources.citation: Any SIL Cameroon rapid appraisal / phonological sketch of Ndzerem or of the Mbokam village speech (none located; SIL Language & Culture Archives search for 'Ndzerem' and 'Mbokam' could not be run because sil.org serves an automated-access block to every download method available here)
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: If SIL Cameroon has followed up Hamm's wordlist with a survey or sketch it would be the first phonological description; existence unverified.

sources.citation: Nkwi, Paul Nchoji & Jean-Pierre Warnier. 1982. Elements for a history of the Western Grassfields. Yaounde: Department of Sociology, University of Yaounde. (cited in Blench & Hamm n.d. as 'Nkwi and Warnier (19xx: 128)' for the Ndzerem migration into Nso')
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: print only (no digital copy found when the work was looked up)
sources.note: Historical only (migration of the Ndzerem from south of the Nun river into Nso'); would not describe stress but identifies the group.

sources.citation: Hamm, Cameron. ined. Ndzerem (Mbokam) wordlist. Yaounde: SIL Cameroon. Unpublished field wordlist, the sole primary data on the language (cited as 'Hamm (ined.)' in Blench & Hamm n.d.)
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: Only primary record of Ndzerem; a wordlist would at most show tone marking, but any future phonology would start from it. Whether it carries tone/stress notation is unknown.

sources.citation: Hamm, Cameron. ined. Ndzerem wordlist (SIL Cameroon), cited in Blench & Hamm n.d. as the sole data source ('Hamm (ined.)', Table 3 p. 3 and section 4.11 p. 7)
sources.tag: not read: abstract or record only
